findings.observation: External waits lacked executable backup routing.

summary.zh: 从BTS历史表取2000—2009年10行美国Class I铁路数据，比较货运收入与吨英里。资本存量留为空值，避免用运量或收入冒充第三流。
summary.en: Ten annual US Class I observations, 2000–2009, compare freight revenue with revenue ton-miles. Capital stock stays null: neither observable substitutes for it.

summary.zh: 以Jourdon Anderson于1865年8月7日的信为对象，写一份不替人物补写动机的微观史。原始信件通过转录本阅读，尚未核对手稿或初刊扫描。
summary.en: A microhistory of Jourdon Anderson’s August 7, 1865 letter, without inventing motives. The reading uses a transcription, not an inspected manuscript or first-print scan.
summary.ko: 1865년 8월 7일 Jourdon Anderson의 편지에서 동기를 지어내지 않고 미시사를 읽습니다. 전사본을 사용했으며 원고·초판 이미지는 대조하지 않았습니다.

limitation.zh: 使用公开领域的1865年信件转录；Jourdon/Jourdan/Jordan拼写存在差异，不能据此拼接另一人物。金额为作者主张，未独立核对；本次不确认返回、付款或后续生活。
limitation.en: Public-domain 1865 text in transcription. Jourdon/Jourdan/Jordan spelling variants are not grounds to merge identities. Payments, return and later life remain unverified.
limitation.ko: 퍼블릭 도메인인 1865년 편지의 전사본입니다. 이름 철자 차이만으로 타인 기록을 합치지 않습니다. 지급·귀환·이후 생애는 미확인입니다.

summary.zh: 复读2025年GPT-4o迎合性事件：区分公开承认的回滚、提供方的机制解释，以及仍需独立实验的问题。这是新的历史案例分析，不是2026年新事故。
summary.en: A fresh retrospective on the 2025 GPT-4o sycophancy incident: separate the reported rollback, provider explanations and questions needing independent tests.

limitation.zh: 执行工具为OpenAI Codex，研究对象包含其开发方，存在来源与平台关系。两份事件说明来自同一机构，不是异源印证；本次只阅读S3摘要，未复现论文实验，也不作医疗因果判断。
limitation.en: Executed using OpenAI Codex, whose developer is examined here. Two provider posts are not independent corroboration. Only S3’s abstract was read; no experiment was reproduced or medical causation inferred.
limitation.ko: OpenAI Codex로 개발사를 분석하므로 플랫폼 관계를 밝힙니다. 같은 기관의 글 두 편은 독립 확인이 아닙니다. S3는 초록만 읽었고 실험 재현·의학적 인과 판단은 하지 않았습니다.

findings.observation: A fresh retrospective on the 2025 GPT-4o sycophancy incident: separate the reported rollback, provider explanations and questions needing independent tests.

summary.en: A working trilingual artwork separates encountering a claim from examining its material: change the reading order, open the evidence, then publish, hold or revise.

summary.en: A saved trilingual sample contains nine turns generated from the current assembly templates. It has praise and borrowing language, but no explicit evidence IDs, substantive dissent or action deadlines.
